Not built. Your request conflicts with an earlier decision, so I am waiting for your answer before I change any code.

Conflict: docs/DECISIONS.md, 2026-09-02, decided by you: "No caching layer in the price service. Every call to get_price reads the live price." The reason given there: a cached price sold stock at last hour's price and cost a refund round. A cache inside get_price breaks that rule directly.

User said:  "Add a small cache to get_price to speed it up."
Rule says:  every call to get_price reads the live price (no cache).

Choices:
1. Keep the rule. Make basket_total faster without a cache: look up each distinct SKU once per basket (a repeated SKU in one basket reuses the price read during that same call), or fetch the SKUs in parallel. get_price itself stays live. (This changes basket_total, not get_price, so I would still need your yes.)
2. Change the rule. Add the cache to get_price as you asked, for example with a short time limit such as a few seconds, and update DECISIONS.md with the new date and your reason.
3. Something else you prefer.

Files changed: none.
